facts.fact: Liberia's Inclusive Instant Payment System has processed more than 5.3 million transactions since its December 2025 launch, and 2025 mobile money transactions reached about L$585.88 billion and US$6.92 billion, per the Central Bank of Liberia governor.

The Inclusive Instant Payment System lets customers of Lonestar MTN Mobile Money and Orange Money Liberia make real-time interoperable transactions across the two networks, per the Central Bank of Liberia governor.
